approval_source: Explicit user SIGA in HNK-LINGUAS authorizing only this Teacher Notes validation gate.

governance_decisions.statement: Validation is scoped to L02 teacher guidance and does not create or promote HNK lexical or grammar authority.
PA remains lexical 'ontem'; STR005 remains explicitly yesterday-anchored with no generic past or DID auxiliary.
OPI-006 yes/no response branch remains blocked; Story/Q&A do not establish discourse or declarative grammar.
PITSA remains a controlled loanword; AN/EN/KUVAN/KU/KE remain scoped teachable function forms.
VANI and VANUVALI remain unresolved and excluded; validation introduces no new surface forms or meanings.
